title: AtlasADE Business Map
subtitle: A product-direction map of sales, customers, stock, payments, reporting, and recovery. Availability varies by workflow and setup.

modules.name: Sales Register
modules.description: Controlled-beta demonstrations cover adding items, linking a customer, and completing a cash sale with tax and a receipt. Card acceptance and other tender workflows require separate confirmation.
modules.whyItMatters: The goal is to keep selling and business records connected. Checkout speed and operating improvements are not guaranteed or measured claims.
businessOutcomes: How does a cash sale become a record?
When can a customer be linked?
replacesOrReduces: Potential alternative to paper order pads (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to manual totals (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to separate customer notes (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to spreadsheet cleanup after the day is over (product intent, not a measured outcome)
modules.merchantConversation: Ask to see the complete cash-checkout demonstration, including customer linking, tax, and receipt handling in the proposed setup.
futureExpansion: Roadmap idea: Register modes by role (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: More guided selling prompts (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Deeper order handoff to kitchen or fulfillment screens (no availability commitment)
modules.status: Controlled-beta demonstration: cash checkout, tax, and receipts. Confirm the current package and supported workflow; general commercial availability is not established here.

modules.name: Customer/CRM
modules.tagline: Explore customer lookup and linked purchase history.
modules.description: Bounded demonstrations connect customer lookup with linked purchase history. The wider CRM vision includes customer context and follow up, with availability and data handling confirmed for each proposed setup.
modules.whyItMatters: The goal is to help staff understand returning visits when customers choose to share identifying information. A product-map connection does not establish a released CRM or loyalty offering.
businessOutcomes: How is a returning customer found?
replacesOrReduces: Potential alternative to loose customer notebooks (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to unlinked receipt searches (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to manual loyalty tracking (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to duplicate customer spreadsheets (product intent, not a measured outcome)
modules.merchantConversation: Ask for a demonstration of customer lookup and purchase history, including what is recorded and who may view it.
futureExpansion: Roadmap idea: Loyalty offers (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Customer segments (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Appointment or service history (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Configurable privacy rules (no availability commitment)
modules.status: Bounded demonstration: customer lookup and linked purchase history. Confirm current access, recorded information, and staff permissions. Marketing exports and configurable privacy controls are not promised.

modules.name: Inventory
modules.tagline: Explore tracked stock and prepared-item workflows.
modules.description: Controlled-beta demonstrations include receiving, counts, adjustments, and checks for tracked stock. The product direction distinguishes tracked physical goods from prepared items; exact item and refund policies need setup-specific confirmation.
modules.whyItMatters: The goal is to make stock and availability easier to review. Do not rely on the map as a guarantee that every sale, item type, refund, or location is covered.
businessOutcomes: How do receiving and counts affect stock?
Which refund and restock policies apply?
replacesOrReduces: Potential alternative to manual stock sheets (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to end of week stock surprises (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to guesswork on retail availability (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to unclear refund restock expectations (product intent, not a measured outcome)
modules.merchantConversation: Ask to see a tracked item reach zero stock and how the proposed setup treats prepared items, adjustments, and refunds.
futureExpansion: Roadmap idea: Low stock alerts (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Supplier ordering (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Ingredient tracking (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Multi location inventory (no availability commitment)
modules.status: Controlled-beta demonstration: receiving, counts, adjustments, and tracked-stock checks. Confirm supported item types and policies; this is not a universal stock-accuracy or overselling guarantee.

modules.name: Payments & Recovery
modules.tagline: Explore tender handling and interruption review.
modules.description: Cash checkout has controlled-beta demonstration evidence. Card and recovery demonstrations are bounded; they do not establish general live card acceptance or a supported terminal/provider list.
modules.whyItMatters: The goal is to make uncertain payment outcomes and manager review understandable. No recovery or duplicate-charge-prevention guarantee is made.
businessOutcomes: Which tenders are supported in this setup?
What happens after an unclear payment?
Which recovery steps have been demonstrated?
replacesOrReduces: Potential alternative to guessing whether a payment went through (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to manual payment notes (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to untracked void/retry decisions (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to unclear manager escalation (product intent, not a measured outcome)
modules.merchantConversation: Before relying on card processing, ask which terminal, provider, region, and interrupted-payment scenarios are supported and demonstrated.
futureExpansion: Roadmap idea: More terminal providers (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Richer reconciliation dashboards (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Guided cashier help (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Offline payment review queues (no availability commitment)
modules.status: Controlled-beta cash demonstration; bounded card and recovery demonstrations. Confirm provider, device, region, and live-processing scope separately. Offline cards, refunds, voids, and settlement are not generally offered by this website.

modules.name: Reporting
modules.tagline: Explore daily totals and review questions.
modules.description: Bounded demonstrations include daily sales, tax, tender, and closeout views. Refunds, corrections, customer activity, exports, and accounting handoffs remain subject to confirmation of the specific report and setup.
modules.whyItMatters: The goal is to make daily activity easier to review. The map does not promise automated reconciliation, an accounting integration, or a faster close.
businessOutcomes: How are tax and tender shown?
Are refund and correction views included?
replacesOrReduces: Potential alternative to manual daily summary notes (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to payment portal checking (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to spreadsheet tax calculations (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to receipt pile audits (product intent, not a measured outcome)
modules.merchantConversation: Ask to see the daily report in the proposed package and confirm the included fields, corrections, and export formats.
futureExpansion: Roadmap idea: Scheduled reports (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Accounting integrations (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Store comparisons (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Report views by role (no availability commitment)
modules.status: Bounded demonstration: daily sales, tax, tender, and closeout views. Confirm each report, refund/correction view, customer summary, and export in the current package.

modules.name: Business Operations
modules.tagline: Explore saved work, roles, and business-day review.
modules.description: Controlled-beta demonstrations cover saved tickets, roles, manager review, and business-day workflows. Exact permissions and the treatment of unresolved work must be confirmed in the current setup.
modules.whyItMatters: The goal is to make unfinished work visible before close. This is not a promise that every exception is detected or that work can never be lost.
businessOutcomes: What must be reviewed before close?
replacesOrReduces: Potential alternative to sticky notes for held orders (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to end of shift verbal handoffs (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to silent ticket loss (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to unclear manager overrides (product intent, not a measured outcome)
modules.merchantConversation: Ask to save and reopen a ticket, review unresolved work, and demonstrate the current business-day close rules.
futureExpansion: Roadmap idea: Shift management (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Labor aware closeout (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Task checklists (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Approval workflows (no availability commitment)
modules.status: Controlled-beta demonstration: saved tickets, roles, manager review, and business-day workflows. Confirm current permissions, unresolved-work handling, and closeout scope.

modules.name: Guidance Assistant
modules.tagline: Guided help is a development direction.
modules.description: The Guidance Assistant vision includes item help, explanations, recovery guidance, and follow up suggestions. Development demonstrations are limited in scope and do not establish a generally available assistant inside a merchant workflow.
modules.whyItMatters: The intent is to offer useful guidance while staff and owners retain decisions. Faster training, fewer interruptions, and autonomous operation are not promised.
businessOutcomes: How would an owner review suggestions?
replacesOrReduces: Potential alternative to printed cheat sheets (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to repeated manager questions (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to unstructured training notes (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to missed follow up opportunities (product intent, not a measured outcome)
modules.merchantConversation: Ask which guidance can be demonstrated today and which questions or suggested actions remain planned.
futureExpansion: Roadmap idea: Store specific knowledge (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Suggested training paths (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Voice guided help (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Owner business insights (no availability commitment)
modules.status: Planned broader guidance, with bounded development demonstrations. General cashier assistance, autonomous decisions, and live customer follow up are not established as commercially available.

modules.name: Content Studio / Social Observer
modules.tagline: Explore business-informed drafts for owner review.
modules.description: Local draft components explore business-informed content ideas for merchant review. The broader Content Studio / Social Observer vision includes trends, products, services, and seasonal opportunities; a live connected offering is not established here.
modules.whyItMatters: The goal is to give owners material to consider and edit. Drafts need human review; this is not a promise of marketing results, safer copy, live social observation, or automatic publishing.
businessOutcomes: Which draft tools can be demonstrated?
replacesOrReduces: Potential alternative to random last minute posting (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to generic marketing copy (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to disconnected content calendars (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to manual campaign brainstorming (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to lightweight marketing busywork (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to untracked promotion ideas (product intent, not a measured outcome)
relatedFlows: Merchant decides whether to publish manually
modules.merchantConversation: Ask to see a local draft demonstration, the information it uses, and the review required before any manual publication.
futureExpansion: Roadmap idea: Content calendar (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Campaign performance review (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Social tool connections (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Approval queues (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Brand voice controls (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Seasonal promotion planning (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Customer segment content ideas (no availability commitment)

modules.name: Integrations
modules.tagline: Connections are a product direction, not a compatibility list.
modules.description: The integration vision spans payments, accounting, inventory, marketing, hardware, and reporting. These categories describe intended connections, not a list of supported or commercially available connectors.
modules.whyItMatters: The aim is to reduce repeated entry and clarify handoffs. No third-party connection, data synchronization, or hardware support is promised by this map.
businessOutcomes: Is a connector or manual export involved?
Which exact device or provider is supported?
What has been demonstrated end to end?
replacesOrReduces: Potential alternative to manual exports (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to copy and paste accounting (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to disconnected hardware setup (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to one time reporting spreadsheets (product intent, not a measured outcome)
modules.merchantConversation: Ask for the exact supported connection and an end-to-end demonstration; a related-area label is not a compatibility claim.
futureExpansion: Roadmap idea: More accounting packages (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: More hardware providers (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Inventory suppliers (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Online ordering (no availability commitment)
modules.status: Product direction; supported commercial integrations are unverified here. Confirm each provider, peripheral, export, and workflow before relying on compatibility.

modules.name: Backup & Replay
modules.tagline: Explore restart, backup, and recovery limits.
modules.description: Backup and restart recovery are related but distinct areas of development. Bounded checks do not establish recovery under every outage, a supported cloud backup service, or a universal restore guarantee.
modules.whyItMatters: The goal is a dependable business record. Merchants need a confirmed backup and restore procedure with clear recovery limits rather than an assumption that every incident is covered.
businessOutcomes: What is backed up and when?
Which restart cases have been demonstrated?
replacesOrReduces: Potential alternative to manual incident reconstruction (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to lost receipt searches (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to duplicate purchase history (product intent, not a measured outcome)
Potential alternative to uncertain closeout records (product intent, not a measured outcome)
modules.merchantConversation: Ask to see the supported backup, restore, and restart procedures and confirm the limits before relying on them.
futureExpansion: Roadmap idea: Cloud backup options (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Cross device recovery (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Owner visible recovery logs (no availability commitment)
Roadmap idea: Guided restore workflows (no availability commitment)
modules.status: Bounded development and recovery checks. Confirm backup, restore, and restart procedures for the current package. No zero-loss, zero-duplication, or automatic recovery guarantee is made.

steps.name: Customer lookup
steps.detail: Bounded demonstrations include customer lookup when a customer chooses to share identifying information; confirm current access and permissions.

steps.name: Ticket creation
steps.detail: A controlled-beta cash-sale demonstration starts with a ticket; confirm the workflow in the proposed package.

steps.name: Items added
steps.detail: Demonstrations include adding items; available item types and setup requirements need confirmation.

steps.name: Inventory/tax review
steps.detail: Controlled-beta demonstrations include tax and tracked-stock checks; confirm item policies and tax setup for the business.

steps.name: Payment scope confirmed
steps.detail: Cash checkout has controlled-beta evidence. Card acceptance, recovery, refunds, voids, settlement, and offline cards require separate scope confirmation.

steps.name: Receipt reviewed
steps.detail: Receipt handling is part of controlled-beta cash demonstrations; confirm format and peripheral support.

steps.name: Customer history reviewed
steps.detail: Linked history has bounded demonstration evidence; confirm what is recorded and who can view it.

steps.name: Reports reviewed
steps.detail: Daily totals have bounded demonstration evidence; confirm refund, correction, customer, and export coverage separately.

steps.name: Recovery limits reviewed
steps.detail: Restart checks and backups do not guarantee recovery from every incident. Confirm supported procedures and limits.

steps.name: Guidance explored
steps.detail: Broader guidance and follow up suggestions are development direction, not a generally available autonomous assistant.
